how: Shanghai sits on a flat Yangtze delta plain with no karst or natural caves; the nearest show caves and wild caving are in Yixing (Jiangsu) and Hangzhou-area Zhejiang, roughly 2-3 hours away.
Shanghai has no hills or slopes for flying; the nearest paragliding training base is Yangzishan in Zhejiang (tandem flights advertised around 680 CNY in 2019), about 3 hours away.
Flat delta terrain gives no launch sites; hang gliding is done at hill sites in Zhejiang such as the Yangzishan flying base, about 3 hours away.
No ranching or rodeo culture in the Shanghai metro area; bull riding and horse sports are found in Inner Mongolia and Xinjiang, a long flight away.
Gucun Park in Baoshan has a paintball/air-gun shooting centre that hosted a 2021 air-gun exchange match; its current opening status and airsoft offering are unconfirmed.
venue: Gucun Park Paintball Shooting Center (顾村公园彩弹射击运动中心)

how: Yunzhou Curio City has a floor of coin dealers plus old stamps and a large weekend market for collectors.

Shanghai hosts the annual PTS Shanghai International Trend Toy Expo with Pop Mart and other designer-toy brands, and trend-toy chain stores operate in malls; no permanent collectors' market was confirmed.
venue: PTS Shanghai International Trend Toy Expo

how: JETRO Shanghai runs an annual Japan Sake Month with consumer tastings, shop tours and 25 eateries and bars offering sake-paired set menus; year-round sake bars were not individually confirmed.
Century Park in Pudong rents electric boats on its lake at about 100 CNY per hour; pedal boats specifically were not confirmed.
